originalTitle: Nothing teases a screen-free AI device ahead of launch next month

content: Nothing CEO Carl Pei said in a post on X that the company’s launching its first AI device in December. That’s just a little over a year after Pei announced plans for “AI-native” devices and an AI operating system. He didn’t give away much about what exactly the new device is, only that one feature it won’t have is a screen: > “Our first AI-native product ships next month. It’s a tool, but one built with the personality and care that have come to define a Nothing product. It has no new screen, and it couldn’t have been an app.” Pei shared an image with the post that says “NOTHING(R)” in the top left corner, above an ambiguous black rounded corner. Last month, a rumor claimed Nothing is planning to launch two pairs of AI smart glasses, including one without cameras, and an earlier rumor said it’s “repositioning itself as an AI-first company” with a shift to AI accessories. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/nothingr-teaser-image-carl-pei.jpeg?quality=90&strip=all] Nothing’s AI device wouldn’t be the first screen-free AI gadget, following the likes of the Humane AI pin, the Friend, and even AI stuffed animals. OpenAI is also reportedly working on an AI smart speaker with Jony Ive. Pei alluded to earlier AI devices, saying, “the whole industry is hunting for its iPhone moment: the pendant, the pin, the glasses, the companion, some magical consumer device that makes AI part of everyone’s life.” He added, “Looking for the iPhone of AI today is a dead end.”
chineseTitle: 无屏幕 AI 设备将于下个月推出
chineseSummary: Nothing 首席执行官 Carl Pei 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，该公司将于 12 月推出首款人工智能设备。距贝聿铭宣布“人工智能原生”设备和人工智能操作系统计划仅一年多时间。他没有透露太多关于新设备到底是什么的信息，只透露了一个功能 [...]
chineseContent: Nothing 首席执行官 Carl Pei 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，该公司将于 12 月推出首款人工智能设备。距贝聿铭宣布“人工智能原生”设备和人工智能操作系统计划仅一年多时间。他没有透露太多关于新设备到底是什么的信息，只是说它不会有一个屏幕：>“我们的第一个人工智能原生产品将于下个月发货。它是一个工具，但它是用个性和关怀来定义无产品的。它没有新屏幕，它不可能是一个应用程序。” Pei 在帖子中分享了一张图片，左上角写着“NOTHING(R)”，上方是一个模糊的黑色圆角。上个月，有传言称Nothing计划推出两副人工智能智能眼镜，其中一款没有摄像头，而早些时候的传言称该公司正在“将自己重新定位为一家人工智能优先的公司”，转向人工智能配件。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/nothingr-teaser-image-carl-pei.jpeg?quality=90&strip=all]Nothing’s AI 设备不会是继 Humane AI pin、Friend 甚至 AI 毛绒动物之后的第一个无屏幕 AI 小工具。据报道，OpenAI 还与 Jony Ive 合作开发一款人工智能智能音箱。贝聿铭提到了早期的人工智能设备，他说：“整个行业都在寻找 iPhone 的时刻：吊坠、别针、眼镜、伴侣，一些神奇的消费设备，让人工智能成为每个人生活的一部分。”他补充道，“今天寻找人工智能的 iPhone 是一条死胡同。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
